description: Unit tests for the ProxyList class in the net/proxy_resolution module, testing PAC string parsing, proxy filtering, deprioritization of bad proxies, and retry logic.

methods.name: SetFromPacString
methods.description: Parses a PAC string to populate the proxy list.

methods.name: ToPacString
methods.description: Serializes the proxy list back to a PAC string.

methods.name: IsEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the proxy list is empty.

methods.name: RemoveProxiesWithoutScheme
methods.description: Removes proxies from the list that do not match specified schemes.

methods.name: DeprioritizeBadProxies
methods.description: Reorders proxies, moving bad proxies to the end based on retry info.

methods.name: UpdateRetryInfoOnFallback
methods.description: Updates retry information for proxies after a fallback attempt.
